resolutions.researcher_notes: Wikipedia's Southern Natural Pipeline infobox states 'Commissioned 1928' -- an exact match to StartYear1=1928. The seed bit.ly/2kjZgVD (resolved via curl -sIL, confirmed NOT the banned abarrelfull) redirects to this same article, so it is the same single source, not a second one. Searched for a second, distinct-publisher source: the two other seed citations (PR Newswire 2016 SNG/Southern Company JV announcement, Southern Company's 2016 SNG factsheet PDF, both fully read) give no founding/commissioning year at all. SEC EDGAR full-text search across El Paso Pipeline Partners' and SNG's own 10-Ks/8-Ks (SNG's own SEC-filed audited financial statements, e.g. Southern Co Gas 8-K exhibit filed 2016-09-01) states instead: 'We are a Delaware corporation incorporated in 1935' / 'originally formed in 1935 as a corporation' -- this is SNG's CORPORATE incorporation date, a different fact from the physical pipeline's in-service/commissioning year (companies of this vintage commonly reincorporate or re-charter years after a pipeline itself enters service), so it is not treated as a contradiction of 1928, but it is also not a corroboration of it -- noted here as context, not filed as a CONCERN since there is no direct evidence the two facts conflict. A DIFFERENT 'founded in 1928' hit surfaced during SEC full-text search (El Paso Pipeline Partners 10-K, 2010) refers to El Paso Corporation itself ('El Paso is an energy company founded in 1928 in El Paso, Texas'), SNG's onetime parent -- confirmed via full-context read that this is NOT about Southern Natural Gas/SNG and was excluded as a false lead, not used as corroboration. No second agreeing, distinct-publisher source for 1928 was found after this search; single-source Wikipedia, so medium/independent=false.

None of the three seed citations state a capacity figure for SNG (Wikipedia gives only length '8,000 mi'; the PR Newswire 2016 article and the Southern Company factsheet PDF, both fully read via pdftotext -layout, give only system mileage and deal-value figures). Located instead via SEC EDGAR full-text search: Southern Natural Gas Company, L.L.C.'s own audited consolidated financial statements (independent auditor's report attached), filed as Exhibit 99.1 to a Southern Company Gas Form 8-K on 2016-09-01 (the filing documenting SNG's transfer into the Southern Company/Kinder Morgan joint venture), state in the General/Overview section: 'We own a 6,900 mile pipeline system with a design capacity of approximately 3.9 billion cubic feet per day for natural gas' -- an exact match to Capacity=3900.00 MMcf/d (3.9 Bcf/d = 3,900 MMcf/d). This is SNG's own primary-source disclosure (an SEC-filed, independently audited financial statement, not a press release or marketing page), so treated as a strong single source. Searched for a second, distinct-publisher corroboration: Kinder Morgan's FY2018 10-K (already reviewed for the P0190/FGT unit on this same batch) instead states SNG's design capacity as '4.32' [Bcf/d] as of Dec 31, 2018, in a table whose stated methodology is 'Design Capacity represents transmission, gathering or liquefaction capacity' at KMI's 50% ownership share display convention -- a materially different, later (post-Elba/Fairburn-expansion) figure from a different KMI-family filer, not a match to 3900.00, so it could not be used as a second source for the SAME number (and is exactly why the value needs a NOTE, not a CONCERN: capacity legitimately grew between the two filings' dates via SNG/Elba Express expansion projects the 2018 10-K itself describes as placed in service Dec 2018 -- 3.9 Bcf/d appears to be the earlier/pre-2018-expansion design capacity that matches the sheet's static 3900.00 value). An earlier El Paso Pipeline Partners 10-K/8-K (2009-2010, also SEC-filed) instead gives SNG's 2008-vintage design capacity as 3.7 Bcf/d (7,600 mi) -- again a different, non-matching vintage, not usable as a second source for 3900.00. No second, distinct-publisher, exactly-agreeing source was found after this search; single-source, so medium/independent=false.
